themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies in Europe
themes.blurb: Across Europe, right-wing and far-right parties are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies, with parallel legislative efforts in Spain, Sweden, Norway, Germany, and the UK. These policies often frame immigration as a security and cultural threat, resonating with nationalist rhetoric and electoral strategies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes local governments for ineffective anti-occupation offices and demands stricter immigration controls, linking immigration to crime (e.g., refs 34, 126, 374).

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Polling data shows 50% of Swedes avoid dating party supporters due to political differences, reflecting its hardline stance on immigration (ref 476).

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes restricting local voting rights to Norwegian citizens only, excluding ~360,000 foreign residents (ref 919).

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Advocates for immediate deportations and stricter immigration policies in Saxony-Anhalt, framing it as a security measure (refs 101, 233, 370).

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes revoking Birmingham's 'City of Sanctuary' status and demands 24/7 security for MPs, citing immigration as a key issue (refs 92, 340, 542).

themes.title: Far-right leaders face legal and political challenges
themes.blurb: Far-right leaders across multiple countries are confronting legal battles, internal party conflicts, and public backlash. These challenges often revolve around allegations of corruption, extremist rhetoric, or electoral setbacks, testing their political resilience and public support.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen faces legal challenges over embezzlement convictions and trademark disputes, complicating her 2027 presidential bid (refs 78, 294, 420, 595).

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Faces lawsuits over alleged misuse of privileged judicial information and internal party disputes over leadership and policy (refs 106, 204, 330, 820).

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Internal fractures as key figures resign, with corruption allegations and legal threats undermining party cohesion (refs 127, 443, 493, 627).

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage faces scrutiny over undeclared donations and security threats following a politician's murder (refs 334, 364, 874, 1078).

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration faces legal challenges, including subpoenas for reporters and lawsuits over policy decisions (refs 2, 39, 184, 331).

themes.title: Internal divisions fracture right-wing coalitions
themes.blurb: Right-wing coalitions in Italy, Poland, and Spain are experiencing significant internal divisions, with factions clashing over policy priorities, leadership, and electoral strategies. These rifts threaten the stability and unity of governing alliances, potentially reshaping political landscapes.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government faces collapse over electoral law disputes, with allies abandoning her and internal factions clashing (refs 12, 194, 301, 498).

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Internal power struggles as Morawiecki defies Kaczyński's ultimatum, risking party split ahead of elections (refs 36, 42, 304, 402).

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Internal disputes over leadership and policy, with former leaders suing the party and regional factions clashing (refs 33, 168, 248, 315).

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz faces internal collapse as key figures resign, with Magyar's Tisza party capitalizing on the instability (refs 119, 437, 592, 837).

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's administration faces internal divisions over policy decisions, with figures like JD Vance criticizing handling of Epstein files (refs 28, 268, 656, 742).

themes.title: Argentina’s World Cup victory fuels nationalist rhetoric
themes.blurb: Argentina's World Cup success has become a focal point for nationalist rhetoric, with political leaders across multiple countries leveraging the victory to promote national pride, sovereignty claims, and political agendas. This theme highlights the intersection of sports and politics in right-wing narratives.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei and Villarruel use Argentina's World Cup success to promote nationalist rhetoric, including sovereignty claims over the Falkland Islands (refs 9, 23, 61, 475).

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage criticizes FIFA's investigation into political flags at World Cup matches, framing it as an attack on national sovereignty (ref 98).

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Supports Argentina's sovereignty claims over the Falkland Islands, using the World Cup to amplify nationalist rhetoric (refs 116, 182, 199).

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's administration faces criticism for politicizing the World Cup, including attempts to influence FIFA decisions (refs 904, 1174).

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian politicians celebrate Argentina's victory, with nationalist undertones in their rhetoric (refs 15, 50).

themes.title: Electoral law reforms spark cross-national debates
themes.blurb: Electoral law reforms are dominating political discourse in Italy, Hungary, and Poland, with right-wing parties pushing for changes that consolidate power, alter voting systems, or address perceived electoral injustices. These debates reflect broader concerns about democratic representation and political stability.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government faces collapse over electoral law reforms, with allies abandoning her and opposition protests (refs 12, 102, 190, 494).

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza party proposes new electoral laws to prevent single-party supermajorities, aiming to reshape Hungary's political landscape (refs 10, 291, 378, 516).

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS explores electoral alliances and reforms to counter opposition dominance in the Senate (refs 36, 990, 1020).

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands electoral reforms and citizen referendums on contentious issues like mosque construction (refs 86, 87, 306).

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's administration focuses on election security and voting machine reforms, sparking debates over electoral integrity (refs 7, 35, 617).
